visual_elements.description: 3D surface plot of a concave function (dome/paraboloid shape) with rainbow colormap (blue at base, green/yellow in middle, red at peak). Two red horizontal lines drawn across the upper portion indicating the maximum level. Axis ticks visible: 0, 5, 2 on vertical; -2, -2 on horizontal base.

3D surface plot of a convex function (bowl/paraboloid shape) with rainbow colormap (red at rim, green/yellow in middle, blue at bottom). Two red horizontal lines drawn across the lower portion indicating the minimum level. Vertical axis scaled by ×10^4 with ticks 1.5 and 0.5; horizontal axes range from -100 to 100.

3D surface plot of a non-convex function with multiple local maxima and minima. Rainbow colormap. Text annotations with leader lines: 'Global Maxima' at highest peak, 'Local Maxima' at a secondary peak, 'Local Minima' at a shallow valley, 'Global Minima' at the deepest valley. One red horizontal reference line. Axis ticks 6, 4, 2, 0, -2, -4 on vertical axis.

3D surface plot showing a gradient descent optimization path. A dark curved line with directional arrows traverses the surface from a high starting point down into a valley/minimum. Rainbow colormap surface.
Blue rectangular label box with white bold text 'Concave Function One Maxima'

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is large, bold, red. Label boxes use white bold text on blue background. Plot annotations use small black text with leader lines. Axis tick labels are small black numerals.
animation_state: Static slide; all elements fully visible with no build animation
recreation_brief: 1. Create a slide with light gray/white background (#F5F5F5). 2. Add title text 'Types of Loss function shapes' in bold red (#FF0000) at top-center. 3. Add a yellow (#FFFF00) circle at top-right with black number '25' inside. 4. Insert four 3D surface plot images in a 2x2 grid: top-left concave dome, top-right convex bowl, bottom-left non-convex multi-peak, bottom-right gradient-descent path. 5. Add four blue (#0000FF) rectangular text boxes with white bold text in the central column: 'Concave Function One Maxima' (upper-left of center), 'Convex Function One Minima' (upper-right of center), 'Non-Convex Multiple Minima' (lower-left of center), 'Gradient Descent Path to reach Minima' (lower-right of center). 6. On the bottom-left plot, add small black text annotations 'Global Maxima', 'Local Maxima', 'Local Minima', 'Global Minima' with thin leader lines pointing to the corresponding surface features. 7. Ensure surface plots use rainbow colormap (blue-cyan-green-yellow-red) and include red horizontal reference lines on the top two plots and the bottom-left plot.
